title: Require HQ App Server Import Funnel
forbids: an HQ application source dependency on server internals, a server dependency from the declarative manifest, or a server package dependency outside the app-owned server entrypoint
why: The HQ app selects declarations and process roles, while the server realizes those declarations. One public host import in server.ts keeps that dependency directional and leaves the manifest cold.
remediate: Keep rawr.hq.ts declaration-only. Route the HQ-to-server edge through @rawr/server/host from apps/hq/server.ts, and use app-local entrypoints everywhere else.
message: The HQ application may cross into the server only through its public host from server.ts.
